issues.failure_explanation: The stated consistency property (L3) applies the heat semigroup e^{t\Delta_g} to u(t) in both terms, but the proof of Theorem thm:added-1 and the concrete consistency estimates in Remarks rem:consistency-first-laplace-sos and rem:consistency-second-laplace-sos use \Delta_h \Pi_h u(t) - \Pi_h \Delta_g u(t). Thus the theorem as stated relies on an estimate that is not the one established.

failure_location.quote: \|\Delta_h \Pi_h e^{t\Delta_g} u(t) - \Pi_h \Delta_g e^{t\Delta_g} u(t)\|_{\ell_h^2}\leq C_{u_0,f,T}\, h^2

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Remove the factors e^{t\Delta_g} from the consistency assumption (L3), stating it for u(t) itself.
issues.overall_effect: The abstract semi-discrete convergence theorem thm:added-1 is not justified under its stated assumptions.
issues.title: Abstract consistency assumption includes spurious heat semigroup
issues.why_classification: The correction is a local deletion of the spurious semigroup factors and preserves all substantive claims.

issues.failure_explanation: The explicit part is written as (id + \tau(1-\theta))U, which adds a scalar to the identity operator and is not a well-defined operator on grid functions. The standard theta-scheme and the convergence proof require (id + \tau(1-\theta)\Delta_h)U.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace (id + \tau(1-\theta))U by (id + \tau(1-\theta)\Delta_h)U in the update line.
issues.overall_effect: Algorithm alg:theta-heat-hyperbolic cannot be executed as written, and the convergence guarantee of thm:convergence-theta for its output is unsupported.
issues.title: Theta-scheme update omits Delta_h in explicit term
issues.why_classification: The repair is a one-line insertion of \Delta_h and preserves the algorithm's advertised guarantees.

issues.failure_explanation: The repeat-until condition k\tau > T causes the loop to stop only after k\tau exceeds T, i.e. at k=\lfloor T/\tau\rfloor+1 when T is not a multiple of \tau, and at T+\tau when T is a multiple. The theorem compares the output to u(T). Thus the algorithm outputs an approximation at a later time, invalidating the stated convergence guarantee, especially the O(\tau^2) Crank-Nicolson case.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change the loop condition to stop at k\tau \ge T (or use a while loop with k\tau < T and handle the final step at T).
issues.overall_effect: The output time of Algorithm alg:theta-heat-hyperbolic does not match the target time T in thm:convergence-theta, so the convergence guarantee for the algorithm as written fails.
issues.title: Theta-scheme loop stops after exceeding T
issues.why_classification: A one-line control-flow correction fixes the output time and preserves all convergence claims.

issues.failure_explanation: For the second grid, x_2=e^{jh} with j\in\mathbb Z. Since H_D has x_2\in[1/D,D], the vertical index j must include negative values down to about -\log D/h. The definition Z_2=\{1,\dots,M\} restricts to x_2\ge e^h, omitting the region 1/D\le x_2<e^h. This contradicts the infinite grid and the algorithm's index set based on \xi_{i,j}\in H_D.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Define Z_2 to include the negative indices needed to cover [1/D,D], e.g. Z_2=\overline{-\lfloor \log D/h\rfloor,\lfloor \log D/h\rfloor} (or use the set of j with \xi_{i,j}\in H_D).
issues.overall_effect: The second discrete Laplacian's bounded-domain setup does not cover H_D, so the convergence theorem thm:convergence-theta is not supported for the second scheme as defined.
issues.title: Bounded grid for second Laplacian omits lower half of H_D
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local index-range correction and preserves the second scheme's convergence claims.
